name: levelgen
comment: Bank v3 (designs/bank-v3.md, research in designs/bank-v3-research.md): the Janus bank, St Petersburg branch, written by tools/levelgen/build_janus_bank_v3.py (edit that, not this file). v2's six levels reworked after real banks: the hall's lantern under the roof terraces, the officers' platform, the safe-deposit department down its own stair, the vault behind its round door and day gate inside an inspection ring, the goods-lift shaft, the sally port, the staff entrance mantrap, guard tours (patrol_*), vents (vent_*), grapple points (grapple_*). x east, z north.
